name: Counter-Surveillance Detection
description: A physical red team operator must be aware of the possibility that they are being watched — by security personnel, private investigators, or protective details. Surveillance detection routes (SDRs) are planned movement paths that create opportunities to identify surveillance through deliberate direction changes, pauses, and observation points. Identifying surveillance before it becomes interdiction allows an abort decision while the operational window is still open.

blue.det: Virtually undetectable — operator is observing and moving normally; unusual stop-and-start movement patterns may appear in analytics.
blue.cm: Irregular security patrol patterns make SDRs harder to execute; randomize guard routes; CCTV with behavioral analytics for extended loitering near facility.
